title: Remove retired Engram init flags from acceptance-policy and readiness live tests
outcome: The two ignored real-binary acceptance-policy/readiness tests initialize their disposable stores with the current pinned Engram CLI while preserving their policy and readiness assertions.
acceptance: The init invocations in src/tests/acceptance_settings.rs and src/tests/engram_readiness.rs use only arguments accepted by the selected approved pinned Engram, with existing explicit disposable home/project placement retained.
Existing acceptance-policy reason-free write/replay and readiness assertions are preserved, or any obsolete precondition has an explicit reviewed disposition.
Relevant focused or pinned disposable checks pass on the exact candidate, and the independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
